E0133

Unsupported operator on `Decimal` (D-DECIMAL1)

What

Unsupported operator on `Decimal` (D-DECIMAL1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0133

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0133: tests/ui/decimal_unsupported_operator.stderr.

Error [E0133]: `/` isn't defined between `Decimal` and `Decimal`
  --> tests/ui/decimal_unsupported_operator.jet:4:11
    |
  4 |     print(price / tax)
    |           ^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `Decimal` supports `+`, `-`, `*`, and `==`/`!=` on matching values only
 Fix: use a method like `.add(other)` or make both operands the same precise type
